Players Committee card image of [[Yoda, Keeper Of The Peace (C-Slip AI 2)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to Coruscant. May lose 1 Force to cancel Force Lightning targeting your character present. Neither player may draw more than one battle destiny here (those destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). Immune to attrition.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/yodakeeperofthepeace_ai2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7deddc7ba5815bab0aff7ba0699002f6647d34 ab7dedd] (26 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
